Acclivity: Surrounded by rocky cliffs, players find themselves exposed with only a few resources at their disposal. It is, therefore, crucial to seek out and secure the surrounding heights.
Acropolis: Battle on the barren slopes of your base as you defend your hill and conquer the enemy's.
African Clearing: Lone villagers have wandered into a forest clearing and must now battle for the control of its sparse resources.
Aftermath: The remnants of a previous battle remain as players try to rebuild their empire and control the still-standing buildings that will aid the players economy.
Amazon Tunnel: In the dense jungle of the Amazon, a wide strip of deforested land serves as the only path between two sets of rivals.
Aquarena: Sea walls shelter players' bases from early aggression, but rich oyster beds and neutral Ports for trading will create a naval struggle across the map.
Arabia: Arid desert with strategic elevations, but sparse vegetation and water.
Arabian Desert: An arid, brutal, and unforgiving battlefield. The open landscape holds only a few forests and scarce resources, leaving little shelter from enemy raids.
Archipelago: A group of large islands. You might not be the only inhabitant on yours.
Arena: The walls around your forest clearing are your only protection from the carnage in the middle.
Atacama: This barren desert is unlikely to quench anyone's thirst, but with its occupants' unrelenting search, its aridity soon gives way to lush trees the deeper one goes.
Baltic: An ocean with peninsulas and sheltered bays.
Battle On Ice: In the unforgiving weather of the north, the Teutons stand to defend their stronghold atop an ice-covered hill.
Battle Royale: You start with few soldiers and must explore to capture more resource camps and military buildings. Watch out for Guardians and other players as they can capture your buildings! The Corruption will envelop the map destroying everything in its path. Last player to survive wins.
Black Forest: Islands of grass in a sea of trees. Follow the paths through the forest to find your allies and enemies.
Blind Random: Chooses one of the following maps: Arabia, Archipelago, Baltic, Black Forest, Coastal, Continental, Crater Lake, Ghost Lake, Gold Rush, Highland, Islands, Mediterranean, Migration, Mongolia, Oasis, Rivers, Salt Marsh, Scandinavia, Team Islands, or Yucatan.
Border Dispute: With both allies and foes right next to each other, there will be an immediate clash for food in the central swamp. Lure in as many animals as possible to your town center before it's too late.
Britain: Expect lots of naval combat in the North Sea and across the English Channel.
Budapest: Two towns and a plethora of wildlife offer unconventionally intense battles.
Byzantium: Rome never truly fell, it just changed continents.
Canals: A network of winding rivers forms a complex web that both connects and divides. Take control of the rivers, but be wary of any flanking manoeuvres from your enemies. The forests surrounding the valley are vast but exposed.
Capricious: Some generations will leave you starving, while others will grant you an endless source of neutral resources. Explore and use the unpredictable environment to your advantage. Adaptation will be the key to victory.
Capture the Relic: Be the first player to capture the relic in the center of the map and return it to your monastery. Each player's monastery is indestructible and you cannot build additional monasteries.
Cenotes: An open land studded with sinkholes but only a few clusters of trees.
Central America: The Aztecs and Maya vie for domination of Central America with invaders from across the sea.
Chaos Pit: Trapped in a forest clearing with no gold in sight, you'll need to carve a path through dense woods to reach the riches beyond. Stay alert - enemies lurk nearby.
City of Lakes: An endless maze of lakes and rivers winding through a sparsely forested desert.
Cliffbound: Arid cliffs encircle the players, confining them within a harsh savannah. Resources are scarce, and space is precious. Early aggression will be crucial to secure a foothold on this unforgiving landscape.
Co-Op Campaign: Select from a set of historical battles and campaigns to complete together with another player.
Coastal: Where the land meets the ocean, with plenty of water and a large landmass for battles by land or by sea.
Coastal Forest: With all the towns positioned on the outskirts of a forested hill, battles are certain to ensue both in the barren south, in the dark woods, and on the sea waves in the north.
Conquest: Win by destroying all enemies in military conquest.
Continental: A large body of land surrounded by the sea; rivers may separate players and teams.
Crater: In the depths of a Siberian forest, an ash-covered wasteland appears, offering little shelter but plenty in gold and riches.
Crater Lake: An island brimming with gold in the center of a caldera lake. Steep elevation and lack of trees make it hard to build there.
Crossroads: Four forest-capped hills loom at the center, serving as the only source of wood and rendering the paths between them most treacherous.
Crownwood: A land of hills where forests cling to the summits. The high ground makes protecting your woodlines challenging.
CtR Monsoon: One of the three most challenging Capture the Relic maps. There is only limited space to build on as most of the map is covered in endless marshes, which in the coldest seasons turn to ice. The relic stands in the center, enclosed in a sacred grove of trees.
CtR Pyramid Descent: One of the three most challenging Capture the Relic maps. Players appear huddled up around the relic atop a vast pyramid but their monasteries lie all the way on the bottom stair.
CtR Random: A compilation of gameplay-enhancing maps designed specifically for Capture the Relic mode! Dozens of wildly different layouts further challenge the aspects of the game mode, and guarantee an unpredictable, yet highly fulfilling experience.
CtR Spiral: One of the three most challenging Capture the Relic maps. The center of the map has been engulfed in a spiral of deep waters and the only way to reach the relic is to follow the current in long and treacherous circles.
Death Match: All players start with huge stockpiles of wood, food, gold, and stone and then fight to the death.
Defend the Wonder: Player 1 starts with a Wonder surrounded by walls and must defend it from enemy players or teams to win. All players start in the Imperial Age with all technologies researched and huge stockpiles of resources.
Dingos: Quickly gather all your livestock before the numerous lurking dingos make an unexpected visit. Use the sea to bypass the predators entirely or strategically invite them into the enemy base for a feast.
Dorothea Quarry: A sunken pit with a central water basin brimming with oysters for those brave enough. Scale the surrounding heights to reach the surrounding forests and additional resources.
Dunesprings: Survive the harsh desert, expand into the grasslands, and thrive in the Mediterranean forests. Claim the rich springs, and seize the deep pond in the centre –  the choice of when and how is yours.
El Dorado: The mythical Golden City lures many invaders into the depths of a tropical jungle. As the Spanish expedition ventures forth, Amazonian tribes await, ready to fiercely defend their homeland.
Empire Wars: Players start with a small town and must quickly ready themselves for battle.
Enclosed: While initially safe inside the dense rainforest, players must quickly venture out to secure resources on the other side of the jagged unbuildable path.
Eruption: The mountainous volcano holds valuable treasures at its peak, but climbing it will leave you defenseless to enemy attacks from above.
Fall of Axum: Surrounded by long stretches of arid land, the Axumite Empire's fortified stronghold towers in the center as invaders seek to break through its walls.
Fall of Rome: Ruins of a once majestic empire, whose armies have all but scattered, have become ripe for picking by the marauding Goths and Huns.
Forest Breach: Some players find themselves trapped within forests, while others immediately clash with their neighbors.
Fortified Clearing: Your forward defenses are strong, but your rear is vulnerable to raids. Secure the central area for a quick counterattack, or outmaneuver your enemies with a flanking maneuver.
Fortress: A walled city with gates and all the buildings you need to build up your forces quickly.
Four Lakes: An ordinary land at first sight, with four serene lakes resting in the corners of the map, it rapidly breaks into a race for control of the much-coveted waters, for they hold the greatest abundance of fish.
France: Re-enact the Muslim invasion and the Hundred Years War.
Frigid Lake: With the ice vanishing around the players, food is easily accessible and plentiful; however, their towns are left exposed and unprotected from enemy raids.
Full Random: Chooses one of the following maps: Arabia, Archipelago, Baltic, Coastal, Continental, Ghost Lake, Highland, Islands, Mediterranean, Migration, Mongolia, Oasis, Rivers, Scandinavia, Team Islands, or Yucatan.
Ghost Lake: The central lake is frozen over, creating a no-man's land.
Glacis: While partially walled, you must leave the safety of your walls to take control of the no-man's-land in the centre of the map; otherwise, you risk leaving all the additional resources to your foes.
Glade: Hidden deep within the dense forest, you must emerge into the extensive clearing to gather resources and establish your dominance. Only by venturing out and seizing control of the map can you hope to conquer your enemies.
Gold Rush: A whole heap of gold and a few wolves in the middle of a desert.
Golden Pit: A ravine filled with gold beckons but its depths loom treacherously as enemies lie in wait on the other side.
Golden Stream: Your starting lands are deficient, but the mangrove river offers a lifeline. Expansion is risky, but the heartland beckons with a wealth of gold. Brave the perils, control the golden centre and claim your rightful victory.
Golden Swamp: A tropical marsh lies at the center of a jungle, enshrouding a small island brimming with gold. The rest of the jungle remains bereft of riches, rendering this swampland too enticing to pass up.
Graupel: Use your transport ship to quickly reach the mainland and settle your base. Despite the harsh weather, food is plentiful. Keep an eye out for where your opponents may have settled.
Graveyards: An eerie environment, littered with remnants of past conflicts. You must navigate the dense mist and secure the vital resources hidden in the graveyards before your opponent emerges from the gloom to challenge you.
Greenland: While food is scarce on the mainland, there is no limit to the fish that can be found near the cold and exposed ice caps drifting in the freezing water.
Haboob: An incredibly open and spacious desert with little to no opportunity to secure your resources. Forest are sparse, exposed and challenging to defend.
Hamburger: The ultimate Easter Egg map. Located on either side of the tasty burger, will you eat through it, or sail around the bun and surprise the enemy?
Hengehold: Stonehenge stands in the center, encircled by relics and roaming wildlife for those bold enough to claim it. The outer perimeter holds many neutral resources and forests.
Hideout: A palisade wall provides only false comfort over the palpable feeling of enemy lurking just around the corner.
Highland: Far from the ocean and heavily forested but with plenty of rivers and open space for maneuvers.
Hill Fort: A fortified stronghold perched on a mountain top may be virtually impregnable but scarce resources and lack of space drive players to expand their empires into the lowlands around.
Hollow Woodlands: Baobab trees mark your isolated haven, a pocket of life within the unforgiving desert. Palm groves and elusive wildlife offer sustenance, but the rough terrain hinders safety.
Iberia: The Iberian Peninsula, including Spain and Portugal.
Islands: Each player starts alone on an island; uninhabited islands may be rich with resources so be prepared to rule the sea.
Isthmus: A narrow strip of desert land flanked by water. Control of the seas will be paramount to harnessing the abundant fish and securing victory.
Italy: Rome has fallen and the peninsula is up for grabs.
Karsts: The open wetlands and rugged karst formations beckon, surrounded by glittering gold and sturdy stone deposits. Secure the riches, navigate the terrain, and emerge victorious.
Kawasan: Food is plentiful but easily exposed to enemies. A massive cluster of berry bushes can be found in the middle, and scattered around the ponds are many relics.
King of the Hill: Control the Monument in the center of the map for the specified time to win. To control the Monument, kill all of the enemy units around it.
Land Madness: With resources scattered across the map and forests surrounded by unbuildable rugged terrain, walling is nearly impossible and military presence will be crucial.
Land Nomad: Lone villagers looking to settle travel scattered across open land. With no water in sight, they must use all resources they find to build a town and ready themselves for battle.
Last Man Standing: No allied victory. Team members must ultimately turn on each other until there is only one player left.
Loch Ness: A slender river slices the map in half, with a small crossing through the middle. With most neutral resources surrounding the lake, controlling the waters will be crucial for victory.
Lombardia: A handful of cities on opposite ends of a wintry landscape must share, trade and coordinate in their efforts to defeat the enemy.
Lowland: Despite the excellent vantage point, players quickly find themselves running out of resources, forcing them to settle for the more unsafe resources scattered in the deep valley.
Majapahit Empire: A maze of mangroves forms at the confluence of rivers, where the Malay harbour a great secret. Their military is strong and will not give in easily to the impending armies of Gajah Mada.
Marketplace: You have conquered a great trading post, but enemy soldiers are also looking to benefit from this impressive victory. Use the markets to gain an advantage and vanquish the opposition.
Meadow: The open meadow offers little to no protection. Forests are limited, and players must fight to gain control of the little wood that the flowering grasslands offer.
Mediterranean: An inland sea surrounded by land; sounds deceptively peaceful.
MegaRandom: Ever dreamed of an endlessly unpredictable map where anything is possible and nothing is guaranteed? Multiply it by ten and you have... MegaRandom.
Metropolis: A total of three town centres await your command. You're immediately plunged into a chaotic environment of having to support a significant population. The clash of great empires begins instantly.
Michi: An impenetrable forest separates the teams of players, until one breaks through and draws the first blood on this infamous battlefield.
Mideast: Where continents, cultures, and world religions collide.
Migration: A tiny island that can't support you for long before you must move to the mainland, where the fighting is fierce.
Mired: Rush out of the boggy lowlands to build your town centre and claim the rich wildlife nearby. But act fast - your enemy is close and aiming to do the same.
Moats: Surrounded by a thin strip of water, don't let the false sense of security fool you. It's only a matter of time before you must escape the safe confines and venture out into the unknown to secure more resources.
Mongolia: Cliffs abound on these parched and endless steppes.
Morass: Take advantage of the muddy morass surrounding the great tropical rainforest. The outskirts are rich in valuable resources and vulnerable wildlife.
Mountain Dunes: Players begin atop towering dunes, overlooking a landscape of shifting sands. The desert is rich in palm trees, but the hilly terrain makes expansion difficult. Exposed stone deposits can be found in the dangerous desert, a perilous prize for those who dare.
Mountain Range: With the enormous mountain range dividing the players, it will be crucial to surmount and control the spine of the mountain so that every battle will be in your favour.
Murkwood: Establish your Town Center deep within the shadowy swamps. Resources are plentiful, and the surrounding waters teem with fish and wildlife ripe for harvesting.
Nomad: Your villagers begin scattered without a Town Center or Scout Cavalry. Will you build a town immediately or struggle to find the perfect location to settle?
Norse Lands: Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and Holland.
Northern Isles: The cold and unforgiving islands of the North Sea leaves you with plenty of resources but in constant fear of enemy aggression from any direction.
Oasis: Nearly all of the wood is in the center of the map, so prepare to be chased around and around.
Paradise Island: Cast away on an island lost to time, where the jungle breathes, and danger lurks in every shadow. Unravel its mysteries, or become another victim of its ancient power - beware the island's guardians.
Pilgrims: It's a race to inhabit the lush and fertile mainland and take advantage of everything it has to offer. Do you immediately settle near the coast or gamble on a deeper expedition, facing unknown perils for the chance at greater riches?
Prairie: A vast, windswept expanse stretches before you, and scattered pockets of woodland offer meagre shelter. Resources are abundant but exposed, and hesitation will leave you vulnerable to your rivals' swift and decisive actions.
Rampart: Twisting earthen ramparts link every player in a maze of elevation. Only few woodlines surround the player initially, but abundant wildlife can be found roaming the lands.
Random Land: Chooses one of the following maps: Arabia, Ghost Lake, Highland, Mongolia, Oasis and Yucatan.
Random Map: Most common game; you choose the settings and victory conditions.
Regicide: Your King must be the last to survive. If your King dies, you're out of the game.
Ring Fortress: Your palisades are partially crushed from the constant attacks, leaving you open to enemy raids, but it is time you fight back and reclaim the rich and heavily forested land.
River Divide: Your starting lands hold little resources, but opportunity lies across the rivers. Utilise your transport ship to explore the dense forests and scout potential crossings. Secure the vital resources, control the waterways, and outmanoeuvre your foes.
Rivers: Players are isolated by narrow rivers; numerous shallows must be guarded at all cost.
Runestones: The open and uncomplicated land surrounding the players makes it the perfect battleground to find the most potent and brightest warrior thirsting for supremacy.
Sacred Springs: The sacred pagodas are home to numerous holy relics and vast amounts of shore fish. These resources are far from the players, leaving them exposed to raids.
Salt Marsh: Swampy lowlands full of shallows and rivers that can prohibit expansionistic building.
Sandrift: Survive amidst the shifting sands, a stark expanse devoid of life. A vast wasteland separates you – yet conflict is inevitable in this struggle for dominance.
Sardis: Break out of your walled base and seize the burning city of Sardis! Capture the central Trade Workshop to generate extra resources.
Scandinavia: In the northern wilderness the berry bushes have all frozen, but there are hungry animals to be hunted and plenty of gold to be found.
Scenario: Play a custom map that you or someone else created.
Score: The first player or team to achieve the required score wins.
Sea of Japan (East Sea): Japanese warships and Korean Turtle Ships do battle in this rocky sea.
Seasons: Four distinct seasons cycle through this map, each bringing its own challenges and opportunities. From the harsh winter to the hopeful spring, the bountiful summer and the fruitful autumn - you must adapt your strategies accordingly.
Seize The Mountain: A prospector's dream looms ahead, on a mountain protruding out of shallows. It is not merely down to who claims it first, but rather whose claim will outlast the others.
Sherwood Forest: Navigate through a maze of trees and carve out your foothold in the heart of the woods. Use the tamed wildlife to explore the deep forest and take advantage of the many animals hiding in the shadows.
Shipwreck: The tide washes against the wreckage, and your rivals are not far away. The race to locate resources and rebuild your civilisation begins immediately. Will you remain near the shipwreck or venture further out in search of more resources?
Shoals: The shallow waters only allow for small groups of fish, but conquering the sea will allow you to quickly reach your enemy, as well as take control of the large gold deposits near the coasts.
Shrubland: Vast fields of forage bushes sprawl across the outskirts, offering immense sustenance. Claim this fertile expanse and forge your path to dominance.
Standard: Win by being the first player or team to destroy all enemies in military conquest, control all Relics, or build a Wonder.
Steppe: Dare you leave the safe shelter of the trees to hunt the graceful deer roaming the open ground?
Stonefront: Few resources surround the players. Wealth lies in nearby quarries surrounded by rock formations that make maneuverability difficult. Map control is key to victory.
Stranded: Quickly abandon your starting island to look for more prosperous land nearby. Construct a town center to seize the resource-rich island, but beware of predators lurking in the dense jungles.
Team Glaciers: A frigid river carves a divide in the harsh arctic environment. Endure the harsh conditions, secure the precious resources of the frozen isles, and control the flow of the glacial river to outlast your opponents in this unforgiving arctic battleground.
Team Islands: One island shared by you and your allies, and another inhabited by your enemies. The islands are not connected by shallows, so beware of enemy Transport Ships.
Team Moats: The surrounding streams offer little but a false sense of security. And with little room for expansion, players must soon break out and claim the vast lands around.
Texas: Relive the classic Mayan and Korean skirmish over the Lone Star state.
Thames: Battle along the River Thames. Seize the Royal Albert Hall to gain a unique bonus or control the south of the map for an unlimited supply of gold and stone.
The Passage: A narrow stretch of water separates you from your foes. This narrow crossing is destined to become a battleground. Control the seas and claim the sacred relics hidden in the deep.
The Unknown: Prepare for the unexpected. Adaptation is not only an advantage here, but it is neccesary for survival. Emrace the chaos, scout diligently and be ready to rewrite your strategies on the fly - only the truly flexible will endure this disorder.
Time Limit: The player or team with the highest score when the time runs out wins.
Turbo Random Map: Buildings create units faster, villagers gather faster, build faster, and carry more.
Valley: A dried up river stands between enemy towns but also poses an opportunity as animals gather there to gulp down the last drops.
Volcanic Island: With stone scattered around in the shallows, the once fire-breathing mountain has since overgrown with lush vegetation and now awaits to be conquered.
Vulpine: Unbuildable terrain surrounding you makes expansion a gamble. Hunt the roaming foxes for a significant gold boost and chop through the central forest to take control of the secrets within.
Wade: The marshy swamp is too shallow for ships to travel and not suitable for buildings to be constructed. Players must use the limited space and resources to secure victory.
Wonder Race: No combat; the first player to build a Wonder wins.
Yucatan: In the tropical rainforest food is abundant, but jaguars stalk beneath the canopy.
